text: Frodo and the Fellowship set out from the Shire.
The Council of Elrond. The Fellowship forms in Rivendell.
The Fellowship enters the Mines of Moria.
Gandalf has fallen. Pause to mourn. The challenge is on hold.
The Eye of Sauron segment begins. The long march through Mordor resumes.
The final Mordor segment. Frodo approaches the Crack of Doom.
The quest is complete. The One Ring is destroyed.
Aragorn rides out of Edoras. The Return of the King begins.
The siege of Helm's Deep. Aragorn holds the fortress.
Aragorn answers the call of the Dead and leads the Grey Company south to Gondor.
Aragorn is crowned King Elessar in Minas Tirith.
Bilbo Baggins leaves Bag End on an unexpected adventure.
The Desolation of Smaug. Bilbo and the Dwarves press on through Mirkwood.
The Battle of the Five Armies is joined beneath the Lonely Mountain.
There and back again. The journey ends at Erebor.
